rules.logic: Fires when BIOC(OutlookEN ASPX Web Shell Written to IIS Web Root) or BIOC(IIS Worker Process w3wp.exe Spawns a Command Interpreter) is followed on the same agent_hostname by BIOC(Reflective Fileless .NET Assembly Load in IIS Worker Process) and by XQL(Cookie-Based STAR-Delimited C2 to IIS Host) within a 30-minute window. Stitches web-shell install, in-memory .NET load, AMSI/CLR co-load, and STAR-delimited cookie C2 into a single NET-STAR IIS-backdoor incident anchored to the w3wp.exe process instance.
rules.name: NET-STAR Fileless IIS Backdoor — Web Shell to STAR Cookie C2 Stitch
